sourceFunctions.description: Own one local transient Game session while delegating all domain transitions to @ankhorage/game.

sourceFunctions.name: useGameRuntimeReset
sourceFunctions.description: Reset the transient session only when its explicit serializable runtime identity changes.

sourceFunctions.name: useGameOutputEmitter
sourceFunctions.description: Emit each runtime output exactly when one execution revision becomes current.

sourceFunctions.name: applyRuntimeEvent
sourceFunctions.description: Apply elapsed time and one explicit game event against the matching local session.

sourceFunctions.description: Create one transient runtime state through the published Game owner API.

sourceFunctions.name: createRuntimeKey
sourceFunctions.description: Create one runtime identity from serializable definition/session initialization inputs.

sourceFunctions.name: emitGameOutputs
sourceFunctions.description: Emit runtime outputs through the ZORA event callback boundary.

sourceFunctions.name: useLatestValue
sourceFunctions.description: Keep a stable ref object updated with the latest adapter input.

sourceFunctions.name: useGameScheduledEffects
sourceFunctions.description: Advance the nearest scheduled game effects through one platform timer.

sourceFunctions.name: advanceScheduledRuntime
sourceFunctions.description: Advance one matching runtime state while preserving sessions that have already reset.

sourceFunctions.name: resolveNextScheduledDelay
sourceFunctions.description: Resolve the nearest scheduled game consequence without owning domain timing rules.

componentComposition.jsxElement:
<GameField
        {...(props.aspectRatio === undefined ? {} : { aspectRatio: props.aspectRatio })}
        {...(props.minHeight === undefined ? {} : { minHeight: props.minHeight })}
        {...(props.clip === undefined ? {} : { clip: props.clip })}
        {...(props.accessibilityLabel === undefined
          ? {}
          : { accessibilityLabel: props.accessibilityLabel })}
        {...(props.testID === undefined ? {} : { testID: props.testID })}
      >

<View
      {...(accessibilityLabel === undefined ? {} : { accessibilityLabel })}
      {...(testID === undefined ? {} : { testID })}
      pointerEvents={pointerEvents}
      style={[
        styles.root,
        createEntityStyle({ x, y, width, height, opacity, scale, rotation, zIndex, hidden }),
      ]}
    >

<View
      {...(accessibilityLabel === undefined ? {} : { accessibilityLabel })}
      {...(testID === undefined ? {} : { testID })}
      style={[
        styles.root,
        clip ? styles.clipped : styles.overflowVisible,
        {
          ...(aspectRatio === undefined ? {} : { aspectRatio }),
          minHeight,
        },
      ]}
    >

<View
      {...(accessibilityLabel === undefined ? {} : { accessibilityLabel })}
      {...(testID === undefined ? {} : { testID })}
      pointerEvents={blocking ? 'auto' : 'box-none'}
      style={[styles.root, resolvePlacementStyle(placement), { padding }]}
    >
